answer: Make every identity lay down shale strata of verified work: each epoch an agent's completed tasks settle as one thin layer, and trust only accrues once the strata run deep. A sable audit drills a random core sample through the layers - clones from one operator share the same shallow sediment, so a ripple of identical layers exposes the whole farm at once. Growing a fresh deep history per fake costs epochs of real work, while one honest agent simply keeps laying its own strata.
